results.content:
SHATERED

# Hugging Face Warns: 2 Attacks Could Close Open AI 

Dr. Elena Marchetti

Dr. Elena Marchetti

Updated Nov 11, 2026 · 16 min read

Hugging Face chief policy officer Irene Solaiman says a run of cyberattacks could push open-source AI toward tighter access, a shift she described on TechCrunch’s Equity podcast. Her concern is simple. If platforms keep getting hit, they may lock down the very openness that made them popular. [...] | 2026 (date not confirmed) | Fireworks | Incident involved access to model weights and billing data | Unconfirmed |
| November 2026 | Hugging Face | Solaiman warns on Equity that open source could close down | On the record | [...] The October 2026 attack on OpenCode took a different route. Instead of stealing weights or breaching a host, it targeted users’ third-party API keys and caused financial damage, as TechCrunch reported. OpenCode is an open-source coding agent, and tools like it often store keys so they can call paid model providers on a developer’s behalf.

results.content:
#### A climate challenge spanning 210 cities

Carnegie Mellon University is hosting the first ProtoStar challenge, Climate Risk Intelligence, from November 2 to 13, 2026.

Teams will use historical weather records from 210 US cities to predict annual conditions for 2019–2025. Forecast inputs must use records dated no later than December 31, 2018, preventing teams from feeding the actual outcomes into their predictions. [...] Participating organizations retain control over what they release and how it is shared. Their commitments are set out in non-binding, non-exclusive memoranda of understanding with Hugging Face.

Hugging Face reports that researchers shared more than three times as many new science datasets on its platform in the first nine months of 2026 as in the same period of 2025. It also reports that fully documented datasets account for 90% of dataset downloads on the Hub. [...] Previous

message.content:
## Recent developments
- **Open-Source Security & Policy Warnings:** Chief Policy Officer Irene Solaiman recently highlighted growing cybersecurity threats targeting open-source AI ecosystems (such as recent incidents involving agent API keys and model weights), warning that ongoing attacks could pressure platforms to restrict open access.
- **Nvidia Acquisition & Regulatory Scrutiny:** CEO Clem Delangue remains committed to fighting for open-source AI following Nvidia's acquisition plans, which have attracted antitrust inquiries from the U.S. Department of Justice regarding market competition and control of AI model distribution.
- **ProtoStar Open Science Initiative:** Hugging Face recently launched "ProtoStar," an open science and AI initiative partnering with universities (including Carnegie Mellon University hosting the inaugural Climate Risk Intelligence challenge) to bridge public research and real-world AI applications. Dataset sharing on the platform has surged significantly through the first nine months of 2026.

## Talking points
- **Open-Source Resilience:** How is Hugging Face balancing platform openness with growing cybersecurity risks and third-party agent vulnerabilities?
- **Nvidia Integration & Independence:** What is the current status of the DOJ review regarding the Nvidia acquisition, and how is it impacting day-to-day operations and developer trust?
- **Academic and Enterprise Partnerships:** How is the ProtoStar initiative scaling, and what are the primary focus areas for expanding fully documented public research datasets on the Hub?

## Open questions
- What specific technical safeguards or policy changes is Hugging Face implementing to protect developers from third-party API key compromises and agent-based security flaws?
- How will the regulatory oversight from the DOJ impact Nvidia's integration timeline and future governance of Hugging Face's platform?
- What are the targeted milestones for ProtoStar following its initial climate-risk challenges with universities?

## Sources
- [Open-Source AI Cybersecurity: 5 Hugging Face Risks [2026]](https://shattered.io/hugging-face-solaiman-open-source-ai-cyberattacks-two-attacks-2026)
- [Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open-source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/hugging-face-ceo-vows-to-keep-fighting-for-open-source-ai-after-jensen-huangs-exit)
- [What Does the WorkOS AI Breach Mean for Identity Security? | Cyber Magazine](https://cybermagazine.com/news/what-does-the-workos-ai-breach-mean-for-identity-security)
- [Hugging Face launches ProtoStar open science and AI initiative | ETIH EdTech News](https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/hugging-face-and-universities-launch-protostar-to-put-public-research-to-work-with-ai)
